meta.title: Snowflake Premier & CoCo Preferred Partner
meta.description: Snowflake Premier and CoCo Preferred Partner: certified depth, direct access to Snowflake's team, and nearshore data and AI delivery across the Americas.

hero.title: A Snowflake <hl>Premier Partner</hl>, and CoCo Preferred Partner.
hero.description: Viewnear holds two of Snowflake's highest partner recognitions. Together they mean certified depth and a direct line to Snowflake's own team, all put to work on enterprise data & AI by one accountable team across the Americas.

highlight.title: Two recognitions, and CoCo Preferred Partner momentum to back them

unlocksHeading.title: Faster to value, with less risk and lower cost
unlocksHeading.intro: Certification isn't a logo on a slide; it changes how fast, how safely, and how affordably the business gets to value.

unlocks.title: One plan with the Snowflake team
unlocks.body: We work alongside the Snowflake account team on architecture, funding, and delivery: aligned incentives and one plan, not a vendor bolted on after the fact.

unlocks.title: Snowflake procurement, simplified
unlocks.body: Snowflake charges for the compute and storage actually consumed. Procuring that capacity through Viewnear means simpler commercial terms, with capacity and delivery under one accountable partner.

unlocks.title: Building with Snowflake CoCo
unlocks.body: As a CoCo Preferred Partner we build data products and AI use cases with Snowflake's coding agent, reviewed object by object and validated before anything reaches production.

unlocks.title: SnowPro-certified delivery
unlocks.body: Certified architects and engineers on every engagement. Snowflake is what we do, not one of ten stacks we dabble in, so every engagement gets depth, not guesswork.

comparisonHeading.title: Three ways to get there
comparisonHeading.intro: Every leader weighs building in-house, hiring a global systems integrator, or partnering with a specialist. Here is where the three models differ.

comparison.big3: One of many platforms they cover
comparison.viewnear: Premier Partner specialists, end to end

comparison.viewnear: One team, owned start to finish

certified.title: Depth that a <hl>generalist can’t match</hl>
certified.body: A Premier Partner is measured on certified people and verified outcomes, not breadth of logos. We know the full Snowflake stack and work alongside the client's Snowflake account team, so the build moves faster with less risk than a generalist or an in-house ramp.
